title: Mal'ta boy: Siberian link to Native Americans
summary: The genome of a 24,000-year-old Siberian boy (published 2014) revealed the 'Ancient North Eurasians'. The study estimated that 14-38% of Native American ancestry may come from a population related to him.
why: Native American ancestry mixes East Asian and ancient Siberian roots.

notes.problem: 'About 35% by one estimate' not in cited page; the 2014 paper's abstract gives 14 to 38%.
